title: openbao-config-mto values
description: Deliberately minimal. This chart is normally rendered by template-operator-v2 from the bootstrap chart's valuesTemplate, so any constraint here has to accept everything t-op-v2 can send -- including serviceAccounts/deployments arriving as JSON null when a tenant has no workloads yet. Only the switches consumed as string comparisons are constrained, because a near-miss there (yes / on / True / 1) silently disables a feature. serviceAccounts, deployments, tierCaps, transit.tierCaps, pki.roles and sso.tiers are left entirely unconstrained on purpose. The boolean forms mirror the bootstrap chart's _helpers.tpl: a boolean, or the quoted strings "true"/"false".

boolish.description: true or false, as a YAML boolean or as the quoted string "true"/"false". yes, on, off, 1, 0, True and TRUE are rejected, because they would be read as "not enabled" without warning.

comment-on-component: `component` is deliberately NOT constrained here. templates/_helpers.tpl already fails on an unknown component with a message naming the valid set, and a schema enum would pre-empt it with a vaguer error while duplicating the valid list in a second place. Schema covers only the switches that had no guard at all.

eso.description: A string, not a boolean: "enabled" or "disabled".
